entities.summary: William James Bryan was an American politician, attorney, and prosecutor who was a Democratic U.S. senator from the American state of Florida. Bryan's stint in the Senate was brief, having been appointed to fill a vacancy the day after Christmas of 1907 — less than three months before his own death at the age of 31.
